checks: both scenarios: actual cash and trend definitions, intervention selection, reference selection
lower-buffer: fold-002 63 dates and combined 189 dates restored
higher-buffer: desktop net-return and drawdown charts readable

limitations: Previously observed retrospective fixed-pool dates; no new independent evidence.
Cash buffer alone changes from 20% to 0% or 40%; position, allocation, fees and risk constraints remain fixed.
Trend filter alone switches etf_trend to rank; factors, ranking, rebalance dates and risk remain fixed.
Cash-buffer relief may have no effect because other caps bind; verify actual weights instead of assuming full investment.
Three folds are independent accounts; aggregate only non-overlapping dates within each scenario.
Two scenarios share baselines, trend intervention and all market dates; do not pool them as independent trials or add their effects.
